slides.h: Hatua zako zinahesabika hata nje ya gym.
slides.en: Your steps count, even outside the gym.
Turn on step counting and your Android phone’s own counter does the work. Off until you say yes.
Record a run with GPS: distance, time and route, saved to your activity.
Set a weekly goal and keep the streak going. The app shows the gap before you lose it.
Join a challenge with friends or your gym. You’re on the leaderboard unless you say no.

rows.en: public is on by default; switch it off any time
